body:
## Goal
Owner 2026-10-28: users see one app named TaskQ, not an app plus a service. Open, hide, quit and restart work as in any app; Dock and taskbar pins survive updates.

## Acceptance
A1. Spec first (R13): menu.md M15 and taskq.md tray line say: Open starts all; closing or hiding the window keeps work running; Quit drain-stops; Restart exists; user text never says service.
A2. macOS: TaskQ.app is always a regular app (Dock icon, Cmd+Tab); app menu has About, Hide Cmd+H, Hide Others, Show All, Restart TaskQ, Quit Cmd+Q; LSUIElement dropped; menu bar icon stays.
A3. Windows: tray menu has Open, Restart TaskQ, Quit TaskQ; Start menu TaskQ.lnk targets <default install>/taskq-tray.exe tray --open; taskbar pin of it opens or raises TaskQ.
A4. Defect fix: a tray of a non-default install (tests, temp installs) never writes the user's Start menu shortcut; the default tray repairs a wrong TaskQ.lnk target on start. Failing test before, pass after.
A5. Restart: drain-stop as Quit, then Open; readback shows a new service generation and one tray pid on both OSes.
A6. Update path: the Dock item and taskbar pin keep the same path across a release N to N+1 update on the live channel and still open TaskQ; Mac and Windows evidence, or Not tested with the exact reason.

## Scope
- src/tray.rs
- src/notify_windows.rs
- docs/design/menu.md
- taskq.md
